gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-kannada: Capture It stands tall and tight, every line drawn with the same steady pressure and its letters nearly sealed shut. Anek Kannada sits beside it with a squared-off, high-reaching lowercase and terminals that stop well clear of the stem.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-latin: Urban in its attitude, Capture It packs its letters nearly closed; Anek Latin is the opposite, with lowercase that climbs close to the capitals. And that closed-versus-open split is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-malayalam:
Capture It looks traced with a single marker tip.

Anek Malayalam sits below it with curves whose tips never touch, and the body text can go a size or two up without losing the tight gap between its lowercase and capitals.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-odia: Tough, tall and tightly shut: that is Capture It, drawn like a laser-etched line. But Anek Odia, a plain sans with rounds left unlatched, is what gives the pair its strongest quality: sealed letters against open ones.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls and c and s shapes that look half unwrapped. Anek Tamil is what a body wants to be, while Capture It does its best work as a flat, unmodulated, towering urban shout.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-telugu: Sealed and stern up top, with Capture It's terminals ending exactly as wide as they began. And Anek Telugu, clean sans-serif with wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds, makes the closed-against-open contrast the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anuphan:
Tall, tight and blunt, that's Capture It, its letters nearly sealed.

Anuphan, a plain sans with big round lowercase bowls and curves that leave clear gaps, lets the page breathe right where the heading holds its breath.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-armata: Commanding is how Capture It hits, a towering x-height with letters nearly sealed shut. Armata does the reverse job best, spacing its characters and rounded terminals generously so the sans-serif text fills the line height with lowercase.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-athiti:
Capture It is a tall, urban slab of sealed letters.

It excels at commanding attention with its towering x-height, while Athiti, a plain sans cut like single-width sign vinyl, does its best work with see-through s shapes and a high mean line.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-atkinson-hyperl: Hard, tall and nearly closed, Capture It looks urban and commanding. But Atkinson Hyperlegible does what the heading can't, setting wide-open terminals on its s and keeping its clipped capitals beside a generous lowercase.
